summary_en: 610,000 shares (3.2% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-03 at ¥2,488/share ceiling, aggregate ¥1,517.68M limit. One-time single-session order.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-auction trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Waseda Academy Co., Ltd. announced on 2026-07-31 that its board of directors has resolved to acquire treasury shares under the Companies Act Article 459(1) and the company's articles of incorporation. The acquisition will be executed via a single ToSTNeT-3 (off-auction) transaction on 2026-08-03 at or below ¥2,488 per share (the closing price as of the announcement date, inclusive of the final special quotation). The company will place an order for up to 610,000 shares, representing 3.2% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock (calculated as 610,000 ÷ 18,561,676 shares ex-treasury), with a total outlay ceiling of ¥1,517.68 billion. The order is valid for that trading session only; partial or non-execution is possible depending on market conditions. Results will be announced after the close of trading on 2026-08-03. The stated rationale is to enhance capital efficiency and preserve flexibility for future capital-allocation decisions.
